serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was angry! I’m an adult man and it shouldn’t be her business to be so nosy about it.
Blaubleim: …
You: I told her once that everything is ok, but she just couldn’t stay away from it. She had to piss me off!
Blaubleim: W-well, I’m sure she was just worried about you. She’s your mother after all.
You: …
Blaubleim: Cut her some slack, I’m sure she’s doing all of this, because she loves you.
You: …
